name: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC)
purpose: How the {{dow.current}} checks that a contractor protects the information it is given.
what: Three levels: 15 requirements at Level 1, the 110 of SP 800-171 Revision 2 at Level 2, and 24 more from SP 800-172 at Level 3.

binds.line: Binds defense contractors and subcontractors when the clause is in the contract.

verifiedBy.line: Self-assessment, certification by an accredited third-party assessor, or a government assessment, by level. The later phases are suspended.

sits.line: Layer 5. It verifies; the requirements it checks are SP 800-171’s, one layer up.

terms.line: A work of the United States government. Lensatic shows the card only for now.

related.line: Level 2 assesses the 110 requirements of SP 800-171 Revision 2.
